independentDiscriminators.name: Omission, supplied denial and captured function
independentDiscriminators.setup: Use the same valid old seventeen-property installer API; compare omission with an own ordinary function returning false. Capture the private composed worker guard through a typed compose callback.
stimulus: Omit nativeToolGuard; use a current otherwise-valid tool record.
Supply a synchronous function returning false; subsequently replace the API property with a true-returning function.
With audit disabled or an invalid invocation carrier, present a true-returning function and attempt the operation through the unchanged private boundary.
oracle: Omission remains literal false and never calls an absent callback.
Supplied false remains false; exactly one call to the originally captured function, zero to its later replacement.
Disabled/current-carrier denial prevents enabling or composing a working audit route; no production/config/caller default is introduced.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: A default true guard, false-as-unavailable reinterpretation, or mutable API replacement that overrides a captured denial.
independentDiscriminators.limits: Boolean success of a typed private guard is not a native source attestation. No publication or provider-effect zero-count is inferred from an upstream dispatch failure.

independentDiscriminators.name: Optional API descriptor and known function types
independentDiscriminators.technique: boundary analysis of presence and structural partitions
independentDiscriminators.setup: Keep all seventeen original mandatory properties valid and compare against one valid enumerable own synchronous data callback. Count subscription, composition, callback and trap invocations.
stimulus: Present an own undefined value instead of omission; remove one old mandatory property; add an unknown property.
Present a throwing accessor or a non-enumerable optional descriptor; use a Proxy installer object or Proxy callback with counted traps.
Present known async, generator and async-generator functions.
oracle: Malformed presence is rejected at installer validation before subscription, composition or optional callback invocation.
Accessors and Proxy traps are not evaluated.
Known asynchronous/generator function classes are rejected without invocation; an ordinary function returning a Promise is instead covered by NTA-06.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Treating an explicit invalid value as absence, invoking an accessor, accepting a Proxy function, or losing the old closed seventeen-field contract.
independentDiscriminators.limits: This design does not claim that arbitrary ordinary function behavior can be classified as synchronous without calling it.

independentDiscriminators.name: Opaque exact agent and unchanged original record identity
independentDiscriminators.technique: identity partitioning with a metamorphic transformation
independentDiscriminators.setup: Reach a valid module plan, observed grant, slot and setupAgent binding through typed old callbacks/operations. After setup registers the exact agent, attach cyclic/non-JSON state and a counted throwing id getter to that agent. Use the frozen ordinary record and frozen plain empty schemas shape of original NativeAdapter#tools.
stimulus: Call the guard with the registered exact opaque object.
Call with a different object carrying the same visible id and reference values.
Call with a Proxy around the registered object; count traps.
oracle: The current exact agent may reach the supplied callback; callback receives the identical record, agent and schemas references. No agent getter runs and no clone, canonicalization, serialization or freeze is applied to the agent by the new gate.
A lookalike or Proxy agent is denied before the supplied callback; Proxy traps remain zero.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Canonicalizing the entire record including its native agent, using id/ref equality as provenance, or wrapping/cloning the callback input.
independentDiscriminators.limits: The existing setup hook reads agent.id before registration. The no-inspection assertion begins at the new gate after that setup; it is not a claim about all original host setup code.

independentDiscriminators.name: Frozen host shape and truly empty schemas
independentDiscriminators.setup: Reuse a valid current registered agent and grant; alter only the shallow record or schemas surface. Count captured callback and getter/Proxy traps.
stimulus: Unfreeze the record or schemas; use a nonempty schema array.
Use an accessor/unknown/symbol record key or a Proxy record.
Use a nominally empty array with a custom prototype, hidden extra property/accessor or a Proxy schemas array.
oracle: Every malformed record/schema surface returns literal false before the supplied callback.
Accessor and Proxy traps remain zero.
A frozen ordinary record with frozen plain empty schemas remains the positive control; the agent itself remains opaque.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Checking only schemas.length, accepting mutable/poisoned containers, or allowing owner-shaped extra proof fields.
independentDiscriminators.limits: The original adapter rejects an actual nonempty ToolRegistry surface before invoking the private callback. Direct private-guard negatives prove the module membrane only, not the native class/hash checks.

independentDiscriminators.name: Claim-bound pending and recorded phases
independentDiscriminators.setup: Build one review and one repair create-mode row independently. The typed native dispatch supplies an exact setup binding with a claim before invoking the captured guard; hold dispatch resolution so slot.claimRef is still null. Later return the same validated worker identity so the module records the claim.
stimulus: Exercise the exact record before dispatch returns and repeat after its claim is recorded.
Remove claimRef, set it undefined, or use a different valid 64-hex claim in either phase.
Return a different valid claim from the typed dispatch, then reuse the prior setup record; substitute another generation/agent record with otherwise equal visible facts.
oracle: Both review/audit_review and repair/audit_repair current exact claim-bound phases can return true only when the supplied source callback also returns true. No preclaim interval is admitted.
Missing/undefined/foreign claim and cross-generation identity deny before the supplied callback.
After recording, both private setup claim and slot claim must match the record; a dishonest typed dispatch echo cannot authorize a conflicting claim.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Requiring recorded claim too early, admitting an unclaimed prepared row, or trusting whichever claim the most recent caller supplies.
independentDiscriminators.limits: Setup-binding equality narrows a private map; it does not authenticate a real original durable claim. A native timeout can record the claim while preparation continues, so pending/recorded is not a publication-state oracle.

independentDiscriminators.name: Literal synchronous decision without result inspection
independentDiscriminators.setup: Use the exact same current valid record in fresh instances, changing only the ordinary supplied callback behavior; count calls and result coercion/then getters/Proxy traps.
stimulus: Return literal true or literal false.
Return a truthy object with throwing conversion/then getters, a Proxy object, or a resolved Promise from an ordinary function.
Throw from the callback.
oracle: Only literal true followed by complete currentness recheck can yield true. All other values and exceptions yield literal false.
The callback runs at most once per guard invocation; results are not coerced, reflected, awaited or retried, and hostile result traps/getters remain zero.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Truthy coercion, Promise acceptance, retry/fallback on a denial, or inspecting a result before narrowing it.
independentDiscriminators.limits: The original adapter may call the private guard at setup, commit and execution. Once means once per guard invocation, not once per generation.

independentDiscriminators.name: Nested denial poisons only its enclosing attempt
independentDiscriminators.setup: A current ordinary callback recursively calls the same captured guard, using either the same valid record or another otherwise-valid registered record, then returns literal true.
stimulus: Observe the nested result and outer result.
Remove the reentering behavior and call again while the original row/grant remains current.
oracle: The nested call returns false without a second supplied-callback invocation; the enclosing call also returns false even when its callback returns true.
A later non-reentering valid call is evaluated normally; the running/poison state does not become a permanent true route or permanent incidental denial.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Allowing recursive truth to override denial, poisoning only one record instead of the active installer attempt, or failing to clear running state.
independentDiscriminators.limits: Later success requires unchanged current facts and original grant; this case does not restore revoked, disposed, finished or expired rows.

independentDiscriminators.name: Before/after currentness, equality expiry and finish intent
independentDiscriminators.technique: boundary value analysis and mutation at the callback boundary
independentDiscriminators.setup: Start from a current exact row. Use controlled typed read facts and the legitimate receipt subscriber/operation paths rather than modifying private maps. Keep each mutation in a fresh instance.
stimulus: At or beyond grant expiresAt, with a dead/stale invocation carrier, or after a typed revoke/control/policy receipt, invoke the guard.

During an ordinary true-returning callback emit a typed matching-task revoke, change the held source/policy/authenticated input association or body facts, expire the grant exactly at the postcheck, or dispose the installer.

For the finish boundary, reach the typed execution/capture prerequisite through existing operations, start workerFinish without resolving its native finish closure, and invoke the guard; repeat after an observed ending finish receipt.
oracle: Already invalid currentness denies before the supplied callback (zero calls); equality expiresAt is expired.
Mutation after the first successful check still denies after one callback; literal true cannot overrule revocation, source/input drift, expiration, disposal or stale carrier.
Finish intent denies before the callback as soon as finishInput is retained, including unknown/in-flight finish; ended slots also deny.
No grant, permission, native send, tool dispatch or receipt retry is manufactured by the guard to recover a denial. Explicit disposal still performs its existing typed disposal path.
independentDiscriminators.counterfactualCaught: Precheck-only authorization, greater-than instead of greater-or-equal expiration, permitting use while finish is uncertain, or stale source acceptance after the callback.
independentDiscriminators.limits: The source-only design uses typed facts/events, not a real store or receipt producer. Full finish/idempotency/held-charge recovery remains in the original retained families; no private-field test hooks are authorized.
